_doc: BR-V8's column member: two leaks on the SAME line are minted in the order b
(column 44) then a (column 13), so insertion order alone would list b first;
the sort key's `column or 0` puts a first. The third acquire carries column 0,
which is not a 1-based coordinate: `_as_col` degrades it to null (absent),
never to 0, and an absent column sorts before every real one.
`x` is acquired twice on line 50 (the second acquire kills the first binding, BR-L6): two leaks whose identity differs ONLY in column — the member that keeps them apart in the dedup key.
